    visible_enemies = get_positions_of_type('enemy')

        enemy_positions = visible_enemies
        target = min(enemy_positions, key=lambda pos: distance(pos, position))
        dx = target[0] - x
        dy = target[1] - y
        # Normalize move to -1, 0, 1
        move_dx = 0 if dx == 0 else (1 if dx > 0 else -1)
        move_dy = 0 if dy == 0 else (1 if dy > 0 else -1)

    if resource_positions:

        move_dy = 0 if dy == 0 else (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
        return [move_dx, move_dy]

    # Priority 3: Expand territory if below goal
    if len(owned_tiles) < territory_goal:
        # Move towards an unowned adjacent tile (prefer moving to unowned)
